title: The legacy first-visit vitals card (waist and BP boxes, a saved reading collapsed with +) still renders in a few rare real states; the rows view covers the same entries
evidence: Done by PR 1508 (16e52776e): the legacy card is deleted (renderVitalsLegacy, legacyVitals, vitalsViewMode, fieldsSaved, renderCollapsedBp and InfoTooltip.tsx all gone from widget-src/src; no .collapsed-field-* or .bp-info-tooltip CSS left); PR 1644 pins the rows for every mirror state in widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.my-data-rows.test.tsx (US-62 AC8 W1-3). Same fix as leads/W1-3. Was: Gate: the card is the legacyVitals slot, rendered while vitalsRows is false (widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx:986, :996), placed only in the weight topic and only once fullForm holds (widget-src/src/components/MyHealth.tsx:166, :170). vitalsRows is true when the mirror held any saved vital at mount (InputPanel.tsx:198-199, latched; the mirror is rewritten on every load and re-read, widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordReads.ts:14, :50), or About you is low with the focus out of the vitals card and no vital typed (InputPanel.tsx:272-278), or the record has a vital and no field save ran this mount (fieldsSaved counts form-field saves only, widget-src/src/hooks/useLongitudinalSave.ts:146). fullForm: stage 4, or any saved value but weight, or a medication, screening, supplement, lab or document (packages/health-core/src/mappings.ts:474-476). (1) States. Stages 1-3, record holding only height and weight: fullForm false, no card. Fresh guest finishing on the birth year (the usual path): the card renders for a moment, then the landing (useOnboarding.ts:72, :77; HealthTool.tsx:541-549) moves the focus to Your plan is ready, About you goes low (InputPanel.tsx:286-296) and the vitals turn to rows. Live 2026-11-13 (drstanfield.com, Chromium, fresh guest): #waistCm present at 10641 ms, gone at 10688 ms, focus on mh-ready-title; no saved reading can exist in that window. Completion with no landing in this tab: the birth month picked last after the year (the tests' birthWithoutJump, HealthTool.onboarding.test.tsx:138-144), or the weight last on Pages, where a weight never lands (HealthTool.tsx:542); About you stays up until the focus leaves its card, so the card stays, fully usable. Returning user, same browser: opened at stage 4 so About you is low at once (useOnboarding.ts:173) and the mirror holds the weight, so rows. Returning user, new browser (empty mirror, so legacy mode): About you low at once, vitalsLeft true, rows; a typed vital could reopen it but none can be typed there (the chat edit goes to the mounted matrix, ChatEdits.tsx:111-113). Record completed in another tab or device (D6) while this tab saved a field: live 2026-11-13, tab A typed height and weight, tab B finished sex and birth; A, refocused, showed #waistCm and #systolicBp with About you still at the top; waist 90 typed and left saved and collapsed to a row (Waist Circumference 90 cm, date, +); + opened an empty #waistCm under Replaces 90 cm. So the open box over a saved reading is live, until About you's card is focused and left (its leave handler is on that card only, InputPanel.tsx:975). After an erase: About you goes back to the top (useOnboarding.ts:152-153; InputPanel.tsx:275), fullForm closes until stage 4; a session that started returning stays rows (mode latched), one that started fresh repeats the fresh path (fieldsSaved is not reset). Record holding other data but no weight (labs, a waist, a medication) on a browser without a vital in its mirror: written by an agent (MCP, CLI) or another device; stage 1, fullForm open, About you up, the card renders with the weight in it (weightInProfile false, InputPanel.tsx:334), and once a field save runs a saved waist or BP shows collapsed with + and opens over its reading. The web cannot make such a record on its own: upload sits in the Blood tests topic (MyHealth.tsx:176-177), shown only with fullForm, and the chat is muted before stage 4 (HealthTool.tsx:714). All results as a table: the table holds the vitals matrix only when vitalsRows (InputPanel.tsx:1011); the card is in the weight topic, unaffected. Phone vs desktop: same panel; the 768px swap remounts it, which latches the mode again from the mirror, so after any vital save the remount shows rows (HealthTool.journey.test.tsx:1195-1199). Pages vs Shopify: same code; only the weight-last ending differs (no landing on Pages). (2) Tests rendering the card, and how they get there: HealthTool.onboarding.test.tsx:926, :957, :1075, :1127, :1146, :1162, :1224, ~:1247, :1318 complete with birthWithoutJump (no landing, a real but rare ordering); HealthTool.journey.test.tsx:703, :731, :1194, :1210 and HealthTool.phone-handoffs.test.tsx:78, :104, :174, :190 and HealthTool.erase-commit.test.tsx:204-214 seed a record with an LDL and no weight (fullForm at stage 1; phone-handoffs then drive the chat at stage 1, which the real page mutes); InputPanel.comma.test.tsx:24-41 (weightKg, waistCm cases), lib/useAutoAdvance.test.tsx:26-36, :55, :89, :135-151 and InputPanel.advance-edit-back.test.tsx:20-30, :73-86 render InputPanel with aboutYouLow true and a weight in inputs, so vitalPending holds the card: a state no person reaches. HealthTool.journey.test.tsx:175 and HealthTool.onboarding.test.tsx:263 click a collapsed value only if one is there. (3) iPhone: no equivalent. Onboarding asks height, weight, sex, birth only (ios/HealthRoadmap/Onboarding/OnboardingSteps.swift:7, :70-74); waist and BP are rows that open their pages (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MyDataView.swift:163, :397-408). (4) Deletion inventory, if the orchestrator rules these states not worth a second UI (proposal only, nothing deleted): InputPanel.tsx renderVital :789-800, renderVitalsLegacy :801-886, renderCollapsedField :566-637, getBpPreviousData :639-655, renderCollapsedBp :662-692, bpTargetText :660, getPreviousPlaceholder :395-401, hasBpPreviousData :415, the fieldsSaved effect :417-431, expandedVitals/vitalsViewMode/bpExpanded/focusFieldRef and its effect :190-213, advanceToDiastolic :184, onIntegerEnter :187, vitalsRef/vitalsLeft/vitalPending/vitalsAsRows :266-278, vitalsRows and the legacyVitals slot :986, :995-1000 (the matrix then always mounts, :1011), BASIC_LONGITUDINAL_FIELDS :58-61, renderLongitudinalField's non-box branches (previousLabel, isExpandedWithData, Previous link, placeholder; :463-472, :491-493, :523, :545-559) and its box flag (only call left :749), imports InfoTooltip, loadFromLocalStorage, VITAL_METRICS, bpSysAdvance, interceptHistory, focusById (:7, :10, :15, :18, :41). Then orphaned: fieldsSaved prop (InputPanel.tsx:129, :164; HealthTool.tsx:671) and its state (useLongitudinalSave.ts:55, :146, :213); MyHealth FormSlots.legacyVitals and rows.vitalsAsRows (MyHealth.tsx:49-50, :127, :137-139, :170); InfoTooltip.tsx (45 lines, its only production user is the legacy BP label, InputPanel.tsx:819) with InfoTooltip.keyboard.test.tsx; CSS .collapsed-field-* (widget-src/src/styles.css:1345-1428), .bp-fieldset and .bp-separator (:1479-1496), .bp-info-tooltip* (:1499-1570, :5262). Keep: renderLongitudinalField box=true and its readable/unreadable, H69 WeightStillCounts and previousReference, savedOf, savedText, hasPreviousValue (heightField, :698), .previous-reference and .longitudinal-input-row (the weight box), .previous-value (ScreeningQuestions.tsx:368), focusById and bpSysAdvance in form-kit and blood-test-cell (AboutYou, StartingInfoVitals), the chat plain-field fallback (still needed for the profile weight box, ChatEdits.tsx:113; StartingInfoVitals.tsx:341). Expected net prod LOC: about -360 TS/TSX (InputPanel ~-310, InfoTooltip -45, MyHealth, HealthTool, useLongitudinalSave ~-8) and about -170 CSS. Tests: the cases in (2) move to the rows view or the matrix, or go; the comma and auto-advance cases point at the profile weight box and the matrix BP. Clinical text unaffected (no rule or wording). Survey first; no deletion PR. (H71)
